name: How do I recognize storm damage inside my mobile home, and what is the repair process?

mainEntity.name: How do I recognize storm damage inside my mobile home, and what is the repair process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of storm damage inside a mobile home include ceiling water stains, peeling seam tape, soft ceiling panels, and moisture along perimeter walls or windows. In Colorado, heavy hail, wind-driven rain, and winter snowpack can breach roof vents or flashing, allowing water to migrate downward into interior insulation and drywall. Before patching cosmetic surfaces, an on-site evaluation should trace the water pathway to ensure wet insulation is removed and the exterior shell is sealed. HH Remodeling LLC provides restoration support to rebuild water-damaged interior drywall, ceilings, and framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for discolored ceiling panels, peeling seams, and damp wallboard. The process requires finding exterior leaks, removing wet insulation, and replacing damaged drywall.
